notes: Save and code straight from the FDL-Editor, with a wider CAFD panel that explains each setting. Your car is picked automatically in Open Connection and the battery voltage works on E-Sys 22.x. Home shows your cars and a setup check (E-Sys, PSdZData, ENET cable). Help shows your licence: plan, days left, Renew and Move. Updates are checked automatically with a notice, E-Sys errors are explained when it closes, a compact licence window, a PSdZ data list in Settings, and many fixes.
